instruction.text: Choose the adverb to complete the sentence.

hint.text: Adverbs can be used to add extra detail about when or where something happened.

atoms.b: Betty has to clean her room ((++soon yesterday)).
((++Normally When)) Maisy’s dad cooks dinner, but today they got a takeaway.
Max looked for her jumper for hours, but it was ((++nowhere somewhere)) to be found.
His aunt lives ((++nearby beside)), maybe she can help us.

hint.text: Adverbs can be used to add extra detail about when or where something happened.
